directory.description: Path to directory containing GRUB files (grub.cfg, modules, etc.).

hold.description: Wait time (in seconds) for debugger attachment. If present and non-empty string, passed as value; if true boolean, flag without value.

memdisk.description: Path to memdisk image file to use.

kexec.description: Use kexec to boot Linux kernels via systemctl (pass twice to enable dangerous fallback to non-systemctl).
